subject: Governance add-on pricing and credit structure negotiation
messages:
From: Emily Carter <emily.carter@medpulse.ai>
To: sergio_alvarez; monica_patel
Cc: procurement@medpulse.ai
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Governance add-on — quick clarifications and budget

Sergio / Monica,

Thanks for the initial deck you shared during the demo. Procurement asked me to get concrete pricing for the governance bundle (audit logs, KMS/HSM, data residency + HIPAA attestation) so they can circulate to finance. Two quick asks:

- Can you send a line-item price sheet (monthly and annual) with optional retention tiers for audit logs (30/90/365 days)?
- What does the HSM pricing look like for both seat-based (per HSM appliance) and usage-based (requests/sec) models?

We have a target budget of ~$140k ARR for the first year for these add-ons, but we can consider a 12-month commit in exchange for credits or a one-time onboarding concession. Are there standard concession levers you offer for mid-market pilots?

Would appreciate a short itemized quote today if possible — procurement is trying to close internal approval next week.

Best,
Emily Carter
Senior IT Program Manager
MedPulse

[Attachment referenced: "MP_Requirements.xlsx (spreadsheet)"]

From: sergio_alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Carter <emily.carter@medpulse.ai>
Cc: monica_patel; laura_bennett
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Governance add-on — quick clarifications and budget

Emily — thanks for the clear asks and the target budget. I attached a concise price sheet (Redwood_Governance_Pricing_v1.pdf) and a short workback (Pricing_Workback_MP.xlsx) with monthly vs annual pricing. Highlights up front:

- Audit logs: 30d / 90d / 365d retention tiers: $0 (included) / $1,500/mo / $4,500/mo respectively (per account).
- KMS: Integration + key management: $500/mo for KMS integration + $0.02 per 1k key ops.
- HSM: Two flavors: seat-based (dedicated HSM appliance, $6,500/mo) or shared HSM pool (usage slab starting $800/mo + $0.05 per request above slab).
- HIPAA attestation & legal package: one-time attestation fee of $12,000 (includes tailored BAAs, readiness review).

We typically offer concession levers for 12-month commits: credits against the one-time attestation fee, reduced HSM seat pricing, or a waiver of onboarding SOW fees. Given your $140k ARR target, there are a few ways to structure this — I propose we discuss tradeoffs (discount vs credits) and I can confirm internal approval thresholds.

Attaching the PDFs. Happy to jump on a quick call if procurement wants to run scenarios.

Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_Governance_Pricing_v1.pdf; Pricing_Workback_MP.xlsx

From: Emily Carter <emily.carter@medpulse.ai>
To: sergio_alvarez; monica_patel
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Governance add-on — quick clarifications and budget

Sergio — thanks for the breakdown, that helps. A few follow-ups from finance/procurement:

1) Audit logs: They prefer 90d but asked if we can offset cost by pushing to a per-record export (i.e., retain 30d live, offer daily exports to S3 for older records). Would Redwood support an export-based retention workflow and discount the 90d line if we use exports?
2) HSM: Seat-based is outside our budget unless we get a substantial discount. Would you consider a temporary 6-month shared-HSM intro rate at $400/mo while we validate crypto workload?
3) HIPAA fee: Can that be amortized as credits over the first 6 months rather than a lump sum?

If we can get close to these concessions and a short term intro price on HSM, procurement will bundle this with the pilot and fast-track approval.

Thanks — Emily

[Procurement: procurement@medpulse.ai]

From: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: sergio_alvarez; aditya_rao; laura_bennett
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Governance add-on — quick clarifications and budget

Looping internal ops/finance for pricing authority and options. Short notes:

- Export-based retention: engineering can support auto-export to customer S3 for >30d retention (we already do this for a few customers), but it changes SLAs for search/slow retrieval. We could offer a discounted 90d option if MedPulse agrees to export older indices daily.
- HSM intro rate: we typically authorize up to a 35% introductory discount for pilots on shared HSM for up to 3 months. 6 months at $400/mo would be a deeper concession than standard; need approval from Aditya/finance.
- HIPAA fee amortization: reasonable; finance prefers credits applied to monthly invoices rather than reducing list price. We can do a $12k credit applied over 6 months ($2k/mo) if deal economics justify it.

Aditya — do we have margin models for MP-2027-089 that support: (a) discounted 90d audit retention, (b) 6-month $400 shared-HSM, (c) $12k credit spread over 6 months?

-Monica

From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: monica_patel; sergio_alvarez; laura_bennett
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Governance add-on — quick clarifications and budget

Monica — ran the back-of-envelope on margins and approvals. Recommendations:

1) Audit log export discount: approve 30% discount on the 90d line if customer signs 12-month commit to add-ons (ensures revenue predictability).
2) HSM intro: approve a 4-month $450/mo shared-HSM promo (instead of 6 months at $400) — gives MedPulse lower entry cost while limiting our concession window.
3) HIPAA fee: approve $12k credit split over 6 months as credits against recurring invoices, conditional on 12-month commit and signed SOW. No change to list prices — use credits instead of price reduction.

If Serge can present this to Emily as a blended concession package (credits + time-limited promotional HSM + export-discount) I’ll mark margin OK and route for final approval.

-Aditya Rao
VP, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
